.github/workflows/linux_build.yml.text:
name: Linux build 
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      duckdb_version:
        description: 'DuckDB version to build against'
        required: true
        default: 'v1.4.4'

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build Extension for Linux
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    env:
      DUCKDB_VERSION: ${{ github.event.inputs.duckdb_version }}
      EXTENSION_NAME: duckdb_rdkit

    steps:
      - name: Checkout Extension
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: 'true'
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Checkout DuckDB
        run: |
          cd duckdb
          git fetch --tags
          git checkout ${{ env.DUCKDB_VERSION }}

      - name: Install System Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y ninja-build build-essential libssl-dev

      - name: Build Extension
        shell: bash
        run: |
          GEN=ninja make release

      - name: Test Extension
        shell: bash -el {0}
        run: |
          make test

      - name: Upload Artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: ${{ env.EXTENSION_NAME }}-linux-x86_64
          path: |
            build/release/extension/${{ env.EXTENSION_NAME }}/${{ env.EXTENSION_NAME }}.duckdb_extension
            build/release/duckdb

.github/workflows/macos_build.yml.text:
name: MacOS build
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      duckdb_version:
        description: 'DuckDB version to build against'
        required: true
        default: 'v1.4.4'

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build Extension for MacOS
    runs-on: macos-latest

    env:
      DUCKDB_VERSION: ${{ github.event.inputs.duckdb_version }}
      EXTENSION_NAME: duckdb_rdkit

    steps:
      - name: Checkout Extension
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: 'true'
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Checkout DuckDB
        run: |
          cd duckdb
          git fetch --tags
          git checkout ${{ env.DUCKDB_VERSION }}

      - name: Install System Dependencies
        run: |
          brew install cmake ninja
 
      - name: Build Extension
        shell: bash
        run: |
          GEN=ninja make release

      - name: Test Extension
        shell: bash -el {0}
        run: |
          make test

      - name: Upload Artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: ${{ env.EXTENSION_NAME }}-osx-arm64
          path: |
            build/release/extension/${{ env.EXTENSION_NAME }}/${{ env.EXTENSION_NAME }}.duckdb_extension
            build/release/duckdb

CMakeLists.txt.text:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.5)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)
# C++17 needs to be specified to compile rdkit
# see: https://github.com/greglandrum/rdkit_blog/blob/master/src/simple_cxx_example/CMakeLists.txt
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED True)
# Set extension name here
set(TARGET_NAME duckdb_rdkit)

set(RDKIT_PREFIX "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/build/rdkit-prefix")

message(STATUS "Building static Boost/RDKit into ${RDKIT_PREFIX}")
execute_process(
    COMMAND bash "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/scripts/build_rdkit_static.sh" "${RDKIT_PREFIX}"
    RESULT_VARIABLE RDKIT_BUILD_RESULT
)
if(NOT RDKIT_BUILD_RESULT EQUAL 0)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "scripts/build_rdkit_static.sh failed (${RDKIT_BUILD_RESULT})")
endif()

set(Boost_DIR "${RDKIT_PREFIX}/boost/lib/cmake/Boost-1.84.0" CACHE PATH "" FORCE)
set(Boost_INCLUDE_DIR "${RDKIT_PREFIX}/boost/include" CACHE PATH "" FORCE)
set(RDKit_DIR "${RDKIT_PREFIX}/rdkit/lib/cmake/rdkit" CACHE PATH "" FORCE)
set(CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH "${RDKIT_PREFIX}/boost" CACHE PATH "" FORCE)
unset(Boost_assert_DIR CACHE)

find_package(Boost REQUIRED COMPONENTS system serialization iostreams)
find_package(RDKit REQUIRED)

set(EXTENSION_NAME ${TARGET_NAME}_extension)
set(LOADABLE_EXTENSION_NAME ${TARGET_NAME}_loadable_extension)

project(${TARGET_NAME})
include_directories(src/include)

set(EXTENSION_SOURCES 
    src/sdf_scanner/sdf_functions.cpp
    src/sdf_scanner/sdf_scan.cpp
    src/cast.cpp
    src/mol_compare.cpp
    src/mol_formats.cpp
    src/types.cpp
    src/duckdb_rdkit_extension.cpp
    src/umbra_mol.cpp
    src/mol_descriptors.cpp
    src/qed.cpp
)

build_static_extension(${TARGET_NAME} ${EXTENSION_SOURCES})
build_loadable_extension(${TARGET_NAME} " " ${EXTENSION_SOURCES})

set(DUCKDB_RDKIT_LIBRARIES
   RDKit::SmilesParse_static
   RDKit::GraphMol_static
   RDKit::Descriptors_static
    )
# Link OpenSSL in both the static library as the loadable extension
target_link_libraries(${EXTENSION_NAME} ${DUCKDB_RDKIT_LIBRARIES})
target_link_libraries(${LOADABLE_EXTENSION_NAME} ${DUCKDB_RDKIT_LIBRARIES})


install(
  TARGETS ${EXTENSION_NAME}
  EXPORT "${DUCKDB_EXPORT_SET}"
  LIBRARY DESTINATION "${INSTALL_LIB_DIR}"
  ARCHIVE DESTINATION "${INSTALL_LIB_DIR}")
